highlights: The Yesido EC14 MFI Multi‑Scene Global Locator is designed for people who value effortless tracking and dependable use across multiple scenarios.
Certified MFi for seamless integration with Apple’s Find My network, it’s ideal for locating keys, bags, luggage or other valuables—home, office or on the go.
MFi Certified + Find My Network Support: Works seamlessly with Apple devices for global locating and lost item recovery.
Long Battery Life: Uses replaceable CR2032/CR2020 battery offering up to 9‑12 months of usage on a single cell.
Compact & Lightweight Design: Small footprint easy to attach to keychains, wallets, bags—portable for daily use.
Multi‑Scene Application: Suitable for tracking across many situations—keys, luggage, pets, wallets or backpacks.
Audible Alert Feature: Supports audible alarms to help locate misplaced items quickly
Enhance your experience with the Yesido EC14 MFI Multi-Scene Global Locator a dependable choice trusted for its performance, durability, and professional appeal.
